notes.title: Game mechanics update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It was an awesome launch and I continue to make the game even better with more feedback! Here are some updates below, and I am hoping to implement steam leader-boards soon so that it can be more competitive with other players since this is a solo player game.


Game mechanics update!


 Game now pauses when pressing [TAB] so you can take the time arranging your gems and reading about their spells/abilities, not having to worry about the chaos going on around you.
 Updated the tutorial and GUI to help inform the player more on the mechanics of the game.
 Added some new features to hopefully help the player understand how to bring out the bosses. 
 Further balanced monsters.
 Added some lighting effects

notes.title: Post launch gameplay update!
notes.notes:
Zoomed the camera out. Will help with three things:

[olist]
 Gives player more vision of map to help orient themselves and see things to access.
 Adds more monsters on screen to add more chaos.
 There is now more room for GUI elements to make the screen feel less cluttered.
[/olist]
------

 Fixed objects to bounce off new camera size.
 Fixed the pressing "e" crash while in chaos totem.
 Updated most font for legibility.
 Updated the tutorial.
 Made the hero starting AOE lighting bigger to start.
 Made first level easier to access boss hint to guide players.
 Fixed a few bugs because of the new camera size.

notes.title: Monster Portal - OFFICIAL RELEASE LIVE NOW ! ! !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38882616/8bc356dd8a16444f644cf716d0cacd9a37d767e6.jpg

Monster Portal – Official Release! 🎉

Today is the day! After countless hours of hard work, passion, and dedication, Monster Portal is finally released! This has been an incredible journey, and I couldn’t be more excited to share it with all of you.

Creating this game has been a labor of love—designing every enemy, balancing every mechanic, and fine-tuning the experience to make it as fun and engaging as possible. There were challenges along the way, but every late night and every tough decision was worth it to bring Monster Portal to life.

To everyone who has followed along, given feedback, and supported me—thank you. Your encouragement, ideas, and excitement have meant the world. This is just the beginning, and I can’t wait to hear your thoughts, see how you play, and continue improving and expanding Monster Portal in the future.

Let’s open the portal together and face the monsters that await! 🌀

notes.title: Little Big Monsters Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

I have been working a lot on the overall mechanics of the game! 

~ NEW ~


 You now receive 3 options when you level that you can choose to upgrade. They range from gem upgrades for every gem, leveling aspects of your given character (like speed, sprint duration, health, health regeneration, etc), or receiving 1 random gem!

 This really adds a lot of dynamic game-play and increases the depth of your character depending on the base path you take when choosing your character before each game!

 There is new music, updated particle effects, and much more! 

 Monsters now slightly increase as you level to balance the game and the base speed of everything has increased. 

 I have updated the main splash screen and character select screen as well.

 There are also numerous bug fixes and code optimizations!


Please feel free to play and let me know what you think! Any bug fixes you report or ideas you have would be great to hear! It has been fun continuing the work on this game and I am not done yet!

Thank You!
